Who it is for

## One trust. Every level. Every board.

A pre-school, a school and a degree college under one trust — each campus with its own calendar, its own courses and its own grade scheme. Distance programmes run on the same system as the rest.

### Every level

- Pre-school

- Primary

- Secondary

- PUC / Intermediate

- Undergraduate

- Postgraduate

### Supports any board curriculum

- State boards

- CBSE

- CISCE

- Cambridge IGCSE

- IB

- Universities

### Every combination is its own course.

Subjects belong to the course. A different set of subjects is a different course — which is how electives and alternatives are carried.

### Pass rules live on the course.

Eligibility and pass conditions are part of the course set-up — per board, per programme, per semester.

### Grades follow the board.

Its own marks-to-grade scheme, and its own rules. ICSE's English plus the best four. CBSE's best two of three periodic tests. NEP 2020 holistic progress cards with no marks at all.

### Exams carry their own weight.

Each exam type has its own weightage, maximum marks and method of evaluation. Term cards combine them by the weights you set.

Admissions

## From the first enquiry to the first day.

The admission fee is raised at the point of admission, and the student record is created with one click. Nothing is re-typed.

The journey

- Enquiry

- Form on the phone

- Documents

- Offer

- Admission

- Student record

### No lead goes cold.

Every enquiry is captured with its source, assigned to a counsellor and given a follow-up date.

### The family fills the form.

A secure link, verified by OTP, filled on their phone. Documents uploaded there. Reminders before the link expires.

### Documents checked, not just collected.

Each one is checked against your checklist, then verified — or sent back with a reason.

### Offers that follow themselves up.

Entrance tests, offer letters with a reply-by date, unanswered offers flagged, reminders before the payment deadline.

### You can see the seats.

A live seat matrix shows what is filled and what is free, and admissions can be opened, paused and closed for the year.

### For colleges

Counselling rounds, allotment lists imported, reported students marked and unfilled seats released.

Fees

## Collected on time. Chased without anyone chasing.

One dues register, fed by

- Tuition

- Hostel

- Mess

- Transport

- Library fines

One dues register

### Reminders before and after.

Before the due date, and again when it goes overdue — SMS, WhatsApp, email or app notification, in the family's own language.

### Late fines, calculated.

Worked out automatically, on your rule. Nobody adds them by hand.

### A defaulters list that acts.

Ranked by amount outstanding. Remind every defaulter in one click, or one family at a time.

### Consequences you control.

Hall tickets held back while fees are outstanding, set per course by you. No-dues certificates issued from the same register, and revocable.

Fee structures by class or course, split into instalments, with concessions through approval. Refunds and concession reversals go through approval and post straight to the ledger. Parents see their dues and receipts on the app.

Attendance

## Attendance is not only inside the classroom.

### On the bus

BoardedDropped

### In class and lab

PresentAbsent

### At the hostel

InOut

### In the exam hall

AttemptedNo show

### Whatever hardware you already have.

UniverseIT talks to any device that answers over the network — card readers at the hostel gate, scanners on the bus, the register on the web, a teacher marking the class from a phone. By day, half-day or period, set per course.

Built for the DPDP Act

## Every approval, every change, every access — on the record.

### A real ledger.

Double-entry, inside the product. Every fee receipt, expense and purchase posts to a voucher and a GL entry. Posted entries are locked. Mistakes are reversed, never overwritten.

### Nothing is quietly deleted.

Records are deactivated and kept, never destroyed.

### Changes are recorded.

Who changed a mark, a fee or a receipt, from what, to what, and when.

### Personal data is masked.

Every time someone reveals a phone number, email or bank account, the system logs who, when and why.

### Privacy tools built in.

Consent, erase-or-export requests and a breach register with its 72-hour clock. When the question comes, your institution has the answer on record.

How it is built

## If it should not happen, it should not be possible.

### Nothing slips through

### Rules are enforced, not remembered.

A user cannot save what your institution does not allow. The check runs on the screen, and again on the server.

### Approvals are gates, not formalities.

Thirty-nine approval points. The right person says yes before the thing happens — not after it has to be undone.

### Set once, applied to everyone.

Mandatory fields, limits and eligibility are set by you and hold for every user, every day, without reminding.

### Nobody waits

### Dhi, your in-app assistant.

Manuals, documents and PDFs are provided. Dhi also sits inside the app, guiding each user to the right app and the right task.

### Report it where it happened.

Raise a ticket from the same screen, without leaving the work or finding out who to email.

### No one is stuck until somebody replies.

A small doubt is answered in the app. Work carries on while the ticket is being looked at.

A developer should never have to ask a user why they did that. If the software allowed it, the software is the one that got it wrong.

AI, on your terms

## Off by default. Yours to turn on.

You never need AI to use UniverseIT. Nothing you enter, approve or report depends on a model. Dhi guides by rules, not by guessing. The product works exactly the same with AI switched off.

And when you switch it on — assessment

- Scripts uploaded

- Reviewed

- Marks & feedback

- Evaluator confirms

- Marks posted

- Progress cards

### The evaluator still decides.

Nothing reaches a student's record until a person confirms it. The model reads the script and drafts the marks and the per-question feedback; the teacher signs them off.

### Your model, your account, your data.

Connect your institution's own provider. Nothing is sent anywhere you did not choose, and nothing runs until you say yes.

Customisation

## UniverseIT adapts, not your institute.

You should not have to change how your institute works to use the software it bought.

### Use your own words.

Reword any screen text or field label in the web apps, per institution and per language.

### Shape your own forms.

Hide a field, make it optional or make it mandatory. The rule is enforced the moment you save it. No new release, no code.

### Your vocabulary, your rules.

Define your own blocks, wings and floors, fee heads, grade scales and leave types. Choose your own approval chains: by campus, by level, by amount.

### Admin in your hands.

Your administrators create logins and grant or withdraw access themselves, without raising a ticket.

Migration and switching over

## The part you are afraid of.

Nobody is afraid of a feature list. They are afraid of a June where nothing works.

The path

- Your spreadsheets

- Every row checked

- Test copy

- Rehearse

- Go live

### Bring what you already have.

Your existing registers and spreadsheets are the starting point. No one re-types a year of records.

### Nothing saves until it is clean.

Every row is checked before anything is written. Errors come back to you as a list, not as a surprise in June.

### Rehearse in a test copy.

Load it, look at it, run a fee collection and a payroll against it. Change your mind. Load it again.

### Go live when you are ready.

Not when a contract says so. The old system stays until you no longer need it.

The mobile app

## One app. Your name on it. Ten languages.

One app, for iPhone and Android. Your institution's name, logo and colours appear at sign-in. One login can hold several roles, for example a teacher who is also a parent. Sign in with fingerprint or face.

### Parents

Attendance, daily diary, homework, results, fee dues and receipts, live bus location, circulars, PTM bookings

### Students

Course content, quizzes with leaderboards, timetable, exams, events

### Teachers

Mark attendance, see their timetable and mentees, approve requests

### Drivers & helpers

Start and end trips, scan ID cards at boarding, hand over only to an authorised pickup, SOS

### Office & support staff

Visitors, gate passes, helpdesk, punch-in, daily tasks

Explore the mobile app prototype

Try the phone and tablet layouts with sample data. No live sign-in or payments.

What it stands on

## We didn't build the foundation. We chose it.

Your institutionOn top

UniverseITAbove it

SAP Business Technology PlatformAt the base

Your data in SAP HANA Cloud, hosted in India.

### Nothing to install.

No server in your office, no hardware to refresh, nobody visiting to put an upgrade in. Staff sign in from any campus, or from home.

### Hosted in India.

Your data sits in SAP HANA Cloud, in SAP's India region.

### Certified infrastructure.

ISO 27001, ISO 27017 and SOC 2 Type II, for the platform underneath, audited every year.

### Built to grow with you.

One campus or fifty, a few hundred students or tens of thousands, on the same platform.

Where we are

## Honest about the stage.

### Built and running.

Twenty modules, 180+ apps and a mobile app, running on our own working tenant.

### Early, by choice.

We are taking on a small number of founding institutions this year. They get our full attention, a direct say in what gets built next, and founding terms.

### Our commitment

If the software does not meet a requirement, that is our shortfall. Every requirement an institution raises is analysed and answered. Where it would serve every institution, it becomes part of the product and everyone receives it. Where it is yours alone, BuilDyn — our no-code, low-code platform — lets your own team build it on top of UniverseIT. A 100% fit is possible.
